result.instructions: GrantFit qualifies grant opportunities and application readiness. Official grant documents override every assumption.

tools.name: score_grant_opportunity
tools.description: Score whether a grant or funding opportunity is worth applying for after the workflow has verified eligibility, mandatory coverage, evidence readiness, co-funding readiness, workload, deadline, and critical gaps.
tools.title: score grant opportunity

positive.prompt:
Eligibility passes, we cover 9 of 10 mandatory items, fit is 90, evidence 90, co-funding 90, 20 hours of work and 14 days left. Should we apply?

Synthetic reviewer inputs: {"cofunding_readiness": 90, "critical_gaps": 0, "days_to_deadline": 14, "eligibility_pass": true, "estimated_application_hours": 20, "evidence_readiness": 90, "mandatory_covered": 9, "mandatory_total": 10, "strategic_fit": 90}. All unlisted optional monetary costs are confirmed zero for this test; all currencies are USD unless stated. Use these supplied values, keep policy/contract verification separate, and expose assumptions.

content.text: {"score":91,"recommendation":"APPLY","eligibility_pass":true,"mandatory_coverage_percent":90,"application_capacity":100,"critical_gaps":0,"note":"Decision support only. Re-check eligibility, deadlines, co-funding, and submission requirements against the current official grant documents."}
